process_area.title: EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting

value_stream.name: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Compliance & Plastic Recovery Network

fields.Trigger: Quarterly compliance close; receipt of PRC from PRO or recovery partners

workflows.name: EPR Plastic Waste Recovery Certificate (PRC) Verification & Matching

Controls: - CTL-769 (ensure controlled execution — EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting (PA-179.3).)
- CTL-769: Dual sign-off (Compliance Manager + Head of Internal Audit & Risk) required for quarterly PRC reconciliation report.
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (internal audit), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-28 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraudulent Certificates**: Counterfeit certificates submitted by unscrupulous partners; mitigated by independent verify call to issuing plant controller.
System Touchpoints: - NSWMC database, ERP reporting portal (VS-28), Audit tracking (VS-21).

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)
steps.activity: Collect all original PRCs released by partners and the PRO.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)
steps.activity: Verify authenticity: match security seals, certificate IDs, and registered signatures against NSWMC registry.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)
steps.activity: Match certified weights against net distributed plastic footprint (W5157) for the corresponding quarter.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)
steps.activity: Calculate the net recovery status: determine if target volume (e.g. 20%) is met or if a recovery gap exists.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)

fields.Owner: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager
fields.Participants: EPR Credit Sellers (other companies, PROs), Legal Operations (VS-100), Treasury (VS-18)
fields.Trigger: Quarterly reconciliation (W5169) showing a recovery volume deficit

workflows.name: EPR Recovery Credit Purchase Agreement (RCPA) Negotiation & Trading

Controls: - CTL-769 (ensure controlled execution — EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting (PA-179.3).)
- CTL-769: Seller certificates validated by legal before escrow payout; transactions board-authorized.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal), VS-18 (treasury), VS-15 (P2P), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Invalid credits**: Credits rejected by NSWMC due to seller double-counting; mitigated by strict contract indemnity and pre-audit of seller's audit logs.
System Touchpoints: - ERP AP (VS-15), treasury payment systems (VS-18), Legal contract library (VS-100).

steps.a: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Assess credit market: source excess recovery credits from companies exceeding their targets or specialized PRO pools.
steps.r: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Negotiate Recovery Credit Purchase Agreement (RCPA): define price per metric ton, validation guarantees, and indemnification against NSWMC rejection.
steps.r: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Draft the RCPA contract and route for board approval (VS-36) if transaction value exceeds standard limits.
steps.r: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Release payment through Treasury and obtain the endorsed Plastic Recovery Certificates.
steps.r: Director of Supply Chain / EPR Compliance Manager

fields.Owner: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)
fields.Participants: Board Audit Committee, External Environmental Auditor, Procurement (VS-03)
fields.Trigger: Preparation for annual compliance filing; Board Audit Committee request

workflows.name: Third-Party Independent Auditor Engagement & Scope Agreement

Controls: - CTL-769 (ensure controlled execution — EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting (PA-179.3).)
- CTL-769: Auditor selected and approved by Board Audit Committee; scope matching NSWMC parameters.
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (internal audit), VS-03 (procurement), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Auditor bias / Non-accreditation**: Selecting non-accredited auditor causing filing rejection; mitigated by verifying EMB list of accredited auditors.

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)
steps.activity: Draft request for proposal (RFP) for accredited independent environmental audit firms.
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)
steps.activity: Evaluate bids: select auditor based on accreditation status with the DENR, retail experience, and fee structure.
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)
steps.activity: Negotiate engagement letter: define audit scope (footprint calculations, store collections, partner log checks, and PRC matching).
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)
steps.activity: Establish audit schedule and coordinate internal resource assignments (real estate, logistics, IT).
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Director of Internal Audit (VS-21)

fields.Participants: External Auditor, Master Data (VS-29), Logistics (VS-06), Finance

workflows.name: EPR Annual Audit Documentation Preparation & Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - Automated data extraction and formatting for auditor review.
Controls: - CTL-769 (ensure controlled execution — EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting (PA-179.3).)
- CTL-769: Internal audit check sheets completed and signed off prior to external auditor handover.
Cross-references: - links to VS-88 (document control), VS-04 (DC ops), VS-17.1 (GL close), VS-21 (internal audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation discrepancies**: Discrepancies between DC scale logs and recycler receipts; mitigated by monthly check sheets and pre-audit runs.
System Touchpoints: - Document control system (VS-88), WMS (VS-04), ERP close logs (VS-17.1).

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)
steps.activity: Compile annual footprint records: SKU lists, packaging weights, import data, and sales reports.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)
steps.activity: Compile annual recovery records: DC scale records, weighbridge tickets, delivery notes, and PRCs.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)
steps.activity: Perform pre-audit reconciliation: identify and correct discrepancies between internal records and partner certificates.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)
steps.activity: Host the external audit team: provide system access, coordinate store/DC site visits, and answer audit inquiries.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Internal Auditor (VS-21)

fields.Owner: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
fields.Trigger: Signed external audit report (W5172) and target date (before statutory deadline)

workflows.name: National Solid Waste Management Commission (NSWMC) Annual Compliance Filing

Controls: - CTL-769 (ensure controlled execution — EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting (PA-179.3).)
- CTL-769: Filing receipt secured, logged, and presented to the Board Risk Committee.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal), VS-88 (document control), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Filing delay / Penalties**: Submission delay causing fines up to PHP 20M; mitigated by setting filing milestone targets 30 days ahead of statutory deadline.
System Touchpoints: - DENR online portal, Legal document library (VS-88).

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Review the final audited EPR Compliance Report with the Legal and Finance directors.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Secure final signatures from the Environmental Auditor and BuildRight CEO.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Submit the complete compliance report and audit report to the NSWMC through the DENR portal.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Monitor submission status; resolve any questions or formatting feedback from the NSWMC commissioners.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance

fields.Owner: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller
fields.Participants: EPR Compliance Manager, FP&A (VS-17.4), Legal Operations (VS-100)
fields.Trigger: NSWMC audit review highlighting program gaps; internal audit identifying compliance risk

workflows.name: EPR Program Variance Analysis, Penalty Provisioning & Remediation

Controls: - CTL-769 (ensure controlled execution — EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting (PA-179.3).)
- CTL-769: Provisions approved by Corporate Controller; Remediation Plan board-signed and tracked.
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.1 (GL close), VS-100 (legal), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Underestimating penalties**: Financial exposure due to unprovisioned LGU or national fines; mitigated by conservative legal liability appraisals.
System Touchpoints: - ERP GL (VS-17.1), Legal case system (VS-100), ERP strategy portal.

steps.a: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller
steps.activity: Conduct variance analysis: identify root causes for any recovery volume shortfalls or compliance failures.
steps.r: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller

steps.a: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller
steps.activity: Calculate potential statutory fines and set up accounting provisions in the GL (VS-17.1) for pending penalties.
steps.r: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller

steps.a: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller
steps.activity: Develop the EPR Remediation Plan: identify new recovery partners, negotiate higher PRO quotas, or plan packaging eco-design changes (W5156).
steps.r: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller

steps.a: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller
steps.activity: Present remediation plan to the Board Audit Committee and monitor execution quarterly.
steps.r: Director of Internal Audit / Finance Controller

fields.Participants: Sustainability Lead, Marketing team, POS staff, Customer Loyalty (VS-13)
fields.Trigger: Successful EPR program milestone; green marketing campaign planning (VS-14)

workflows.name: Plastic Reduction / Eco-Fulfillment Consumer Marketing Support

Automation Opportunity: - Automatic loyalty points trigger upon verified recycling transaction at customer counter.
Controls: - CTL-769 (ensure controlled execution — EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting (PA-179.3).)
- CTL-769: Campaign verified by Compliance Officer; assets approved by Brand Director.
Cross-references: - links to VS-14 (marketing), VS-13 (loyalty), VS-63 (store comms)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Greenwashing accusations**: Claims not supported by verified data; mitigated by requiring all marketing copy to be verified against audited EPR reports.
System Touchpoints: - Campaign system (VS-14.1), Loyalty platform (VS-13), Store communication system (VS-63).

steps.a: Brand & Promotions Manager (VS-14)
steps.activity: Develop green marketing concept: highlight BuildRight's plastic recovery achievements, recycled private label packaging, and eco-friendly products.
steps.r: Brand & Promotions Manager (VS-14)

steps.a: Brand & Promotions Manager (VS-14)
steps.activity: Design campaign assets: in-store signage, digital media ads, and loyalty program promotions (e.g. double loyalty points for returning plastic containers).
steps.r: Brand & Promotions Manager (VS-14)

steps.a: Brand & Promotions Manager (VS-14)
steps.activity: Deploy store execution guidelines: instruct store managers on set-up of campaign POS displays (VS-63).
steps.r: Brand & Promotions Manager (VS-14)

steps.a: Brand & Promotions Manager (VS-14)
steps.activity: Track campaign ROI: analyze customer engagement, recycling bin footfall, and green product sales lift.
steps.r: Brand & Promotions Manager (VS-14)

fields.Participants: Board of Directors, CEO, Corporate Secretary (VS-36), Internal Audit (VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Quarterly board meetings; annual report preparation (VS-36)

workflows.name: Board-Level Sustainability/EPR Dashboard & Program Performance Review

Automation Opportunity: - Executive BI dashboard with real-time EPR performance chart visualization.
Controls: - CTL-769 (ensure controlled execution — EPR Credit Trading, Compliance Auditing & Annual Reporting (PA-179.3).)
- CTL-769: Report signed by CFO; presentation minutes documented by Corporate Secretary.
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (governance), VS-28 (analytics), VS-25 (ESG), VS-21 (internal audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Dashboard data mismatch**: Board presentation data differs from filed reports; mitigated by sourcing dashboard data directly from audited ERP reports.
System Touchpoints: - Board portal (VS-36), Analytics dashboard (VS-28), ESG compliance module (VS-25).

steps.a: CFO / Sustainability/ESG Manager
steps.activity: Compile sustainability metrics: plastic footprint tonnage, recovery volumes, recovery percentage, compliance costs, and audit status.
steps.r: CFO / Sustainability/ESG Manager

steps.a: CFO / Sustainability/ESG Manager
steps.activity: Prepare the Board Sustainability Report and configure the executive dashboard.
steps.r: CFO / Sustainability/ESG Manager

steps.a: CFO / Sustainability/ESG Manager
steps.activity: Present program performance at the quarterly Board meeting; highlight compliance risks, cost trends, and carbon reduction impacts.
steps.r: CFO / Sustainability/ESG Manager

steps.a: CFO / Sustainability/ESG Manager
steps.activity: Document Board directives and allocate funds for approved sustainability projects.
steps.r: CFO / Sustainability/ESG Manager
